summary: Iteration 62 — Auth end-to-end regression on PREVIEW after MongoDB Atlas password rotation and UI rebrand/mobile refactor. Backend: admin login, /auth/me, seller login (with non-null store_id), stores-featured listing, /api/stores/sophia_style all HTTP 200. Frontend: /login form submit works at both 1280x900 (desktop) and 390x844 (mobile) — POST /api/auth/login → 200, localStorage 'mercari-global_token' set, redirect to / and Logout button visible. Rate-limiter accepts unknown-email requests without 500. Preview auth is fully functional; the user's report is consistent with the PROD deployment still pointing MONGO_URL at the dead '8207@Bit' password.

issues: React console warning: 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' from TrustStrip render — non-blocking but should be fixed.

rca of the issue: User reported login failures against the deployed (prod) URL. Preview /login works end-to-end with HTTP 200 and JWT persistence at both desktop and mobile viewports. Preview backend/.env carries the new Atlas password. The dead password '8207@Bit' is still baked into the prod pod's MONGO_URL env var per /app/memory/test_credentials.md checklist — that pod cannot open a Mongo connection, so every /api/auth/login (and any other DB-backed endpoint) fails there. Mitigation: update prod MONGO_URL env var in Emergent Deploy dashboard to the new connection string and redeploy.
